36: @HiltViewModel
37: class SettingsViewModel @Inject constructor(
38:     private val userDataRepository: UserDataRepository,
39:     private val preferences: NiaPreferencesDataSource,
40: ) : ViewModel() {
41:     val settingsUiState: StateFlow<SettingsUiState> =
42:         userDataRepository.userData
43:             .map { userData ->
44:                 Success(
45:                     settings = UserEditableSettings(
46:                         brand = userData.themeBrand,
47:                         useDynamicColor = userData.useDynamicColor,
48:                         darkThemeConfig = userData.darkThemeConfig,
49:                     ),
50:                 )
51:             }
52:             .stateIn(
53:                 scope = viewModelScope,
54:                 started = WhileSubscribed(5.seconds.inWholeMilliseconds),
55:                 initialValue = Loading,
56:             )
57: 
58:     fun resetAppearance() {
59:         viewModelScope.launch {
60:             preferences.setThemeBrand(ThemeBrand.DEFAULT)
61:             preferences.setDarkThemeConfig(DarkThemeConfig.FOLLOW_SYSTEM)
62:             preferences.setDynamicColorPreference(false)
63:         }
64:     }
65: 
66:     fun updateThemeBrand(themeBrand: ThemeBrand) {
67:         viewModelScope.launch {
68:             userDataRepository.setThemeBrand(themeBrand)
69:         }
70:     }
71: 
72:     fun updateDarkThemeConfig(darkThemeConfig: DarkThemeConfig) {
73:         viewModelScope.launch {
74:             userDataRepository.setDarkThemeConfig(darkThemeConfig)
75:         }
76:     }
77:
